subject: Startups
title: Contractor vs. Employee
description: A fast breakdown of Contractor vs. Employee for builders.

hook.text: Calling workers 'contractors' to avoid paying benefits is one of most common—and expensive—legal mistakes startups make.

buildup.text: The IRS and state agencies use strict tests: if you control how and when someone works, they're likely an employee.

discovery.text: Misclassification can trigger back taxes, penalties, and lawsuits.

twist.text: Uber and Lyft built empires on contractor classification. Then faced billions in legal costs when governments disagreed.

climax.text: When in doubt, hire as employees. The cost of misclassification far exceeds the savings from avoiding benefits.

punchline.text: Cheap today, lawsuit tomorrow. Classify workers correctly.

quiz.question: What determines if someone is an employee vs. a contractor?
options: How much control the company has over their work
